text:
Maria: FYI customer reported streaming output that just stops before the final object — client reconnect shows leftover comma and missing finish_reason. They see no error on client.
Alex: Ugh, which SDK + version? with curl or browser?
Maria: Node fetch (v3) on their side. Server -> Redwood hosted API (prod). Repro steps they gave: 
```
curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-open","stream":true,"input":"summarize..."}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams
```
Response ends with `data: ,` and no final `data: [DONE]` or finish token.
Ingrid: Did they rotate the auth key mid-stream? that can cause proxy to reset connection sometimes.
Maria: They said they refreshed tokens in client while stream open (auth refresh every 5m).
Samir: Can we get the server side request id / request headers? need the `x-rw-request-id` and edge proxy logs.
Maria: Pasted snippet from client console (sanitized): 
```
[stream] event: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"..."}} ,
[stream] event: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"."}} ,
[stream] event: {"choices":[{"delta":{}}   // last event truncated
```
No `finish_reason` field.
Alex: This looks like truncated last chunk + trailing comma. Could be our load balancer dropping final flush when upstream connection resets during auth handshake.
eng-runtime-bot: New trace created: trace_id=trc_01GZPZXXXX, route=/v1/streams, latency=312ms, upstream-retries=1
Samir: +1 to capturing full edge proxy trace. Maria can you ask customer for the exact `x-request-start` and full response size? Also whether they're using keepalive or HTTP/2 multiplexing.
Maria: Asking now. also logged repro that sometimes they can rejoin and receive earlier tokens but final JSON is invalid (extra comma).
Ingrid: If auth rotation is the trigger we should reproduce locally by doing a token swap mid-stream with a reverse-proxy that returns 401 then reauth. I'll spin up a quick harness.
Alex: In the meantime set support workaround: tell customer to avoid rotating key while streaming or switch to short-lived session-level token for the stream. Also ask them to enable `stream_resume` header if available.
Maria: Customer tried with `Retry-After` backoff and reconnect; when they reconnect our resume header `x-rw-resume` didn't match and the client appended a comma leading to invalid JSON.
Samir: That indicates resume semantics mismatch — resume should only append complete chunks. I'll open an eng-runtime ticket. Assigning to @Ingrid and @Alex for root cause. Marking P2 for now pending customer business impact.
Ingrid: I have a quick repro plan: 1) start stream, 2) trigger auth refresh that returns 401 on the edge, 3) have client reconnect with original resume token. If we see truncated last event or missing finish_reason we confirm bug.
Alex: Suggested mitigation: ensure edge sends a terminal `data: [ERROR]` if upstream reset occurs. Also add server-side flush of final event before lock-step auth rotation.
Maria: Customer confirmed they can reproduce 70% of the time when token refresh occurs at 80-90% through output.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: runtime patch (flush-on-rotate) scheduled to canary at 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z — changelist CL-9988.
Samir: Good. Maria, please collect the customer's `x-rw-request-id` samples and attach to the new ticket. Also include client SDK version & node version.
Maria: Will do. Closing loop with customer: suggested temporary workaround (avoid mid-stream auth rotation) and ETA for canary. They accepted. :thumbsup:
Alex: Thanks team — follow up after canary results.
